title: Page 3
content_zh:
因为半个月都等不到他的答复，所以她干脆直接去找他母亲试一下水温，想看看杜母挑媳妇的眼光是否真如他所说的那样严苛……好吧，她承认此举其实也包含了一点想挑衅他的意味，因为如果杜母对她留下好印象的话，往后他就不能拿父母来当拒绝她的借口了，不是吗？
杜天海看着她那炯炯有光、理直气壮的眼神，白净秀致的脸上还缀着一抹慧黠的……
“聪明的女人。”他浅挑浓眉，轻抿薄唇，倜傥不羁的脸上颇是玩味。
忽地丢出这么一句，他的话听来更教人玩味，让她弄不清他言下之意是褒是贬。这句“聪明”是真在夸她，还是暗讽她心机重？
“你要带我去哪里？”参不透他话中的玄机，她有些倔气地不肯开口问明白，转而询问他们的目的地。
“把你卖了。”他勾起唇，不很正经地回话。
“劳烦替我喊个好价钱。”她不冷不热地说，倒希望自己真能值一大笔钱。这些日子她到处找人周转，长短钉子碰了一堆，真的缺很大。
“哈哈……没问题，包在我身上。”他朗声大笑，没想到这个一脸严肃的女人居然还会附和他冷笑话。
这就是让他觉得最有趣的地方！一个个性拘谨，看起来有些古板的女人，却不时会做出一些出人意料的举动，这真是愈来愈对他的味了。
无聊！有那么好笑吗？
她冷瞅了他一眼，觉得这男人的想法真的让人难以理解。要是哪天摸透了他，八成她自己也精神异常了。
她撑着车窗向外望，一路上不再说话。
约莫二十分钟后，他们到达一家采会员制的酒吧，其中一个半开放式的包厢内已经坐了一群他的朋友，男男女女一见到他就高声招呼，尤其是几位打扮火辣的女性特别热情。
“阿海……”
“小海……”
“海……”
嗲声嗲气的声音此起彼落，佟映晨的耳朵简直像被一片“海浪声”给淹没，连人也被争着靠近他身边的女人给挤到后头去……
她也不吭声，就这么默默地站在后头，看他跟一群女人寒暄了一阵，才有人发现她的存在。
“她是谁？”有个浓妆艳抹的女人指着佟映晨问道，口气显然不归友善那一类。
“对呀，她是谁？”众人纷纷把目光投射到她身上，杜天海顺手搂住那女人的肩膀，也回过头来看着她。

他看她，她也看他。佟映晨面对众人的好奇目光笑而不语，决定把这问题留给杜天海来回答，既然他把她带到这里来，势必也料到会被问到这个问题了。
她望着他，本身也很想知道自己在他心中究竟是被界定为何种身分。关于她的提议，他还没给个答复呢。
“这一位……她是身价很高的佟映晨小姐，所以除了她的名字以外，我不能透露更多了。”他动作夸张地把手一扬，隆重地介绍她的名字，却含糊地带过她的身分。
大伙把他的“演出”当成轻松逗趣的笑话，一阵大笑中倒也没再往下追问，反正大家都是出来喝酒玩乐而已，没人会太认真的去探究谁的背景。
女人们看杜天海还搂着身旁的女人，似乎不是很在意佟映晨的存在，也就不再把注意力停留在她身上了。
“海，过来坐这儿。”
“不，你过来坐这里啦……”几个女人又为了杜天海的座位展开一阵争夺，拉扯了好一会儿才决定他的位置。
佟映晨就坐在他的斜对面，看着他很受欢迎地被两派女人夹在中间，脸上的神情似乎挺习惯，也挺享受这样的簇拥……
数据上写得没错，这男人果然很有女人缘呀！
“想喝什么？”坐在佟映晨身边的男人靠过来问她。
她想了一下，说：“可乐。”
“蛤？！”男人的嘴巴就像刚烤好的蛤蜊般
“可、乐。”她慢慢地、大声地重复一次，以为对方是因为现场的音乐太吵而没听清楚。其实她本来想点乌龙茶的，但酒吧里应该没有。
“你在开玩笑吧！没人来这里喝汽水的。”男人讽刺地笑道，心想这里又不是招待小朋友的快餐店，谁会喝不含酒精的饮料？
“我就是，我要喝可乐。”她表情一冷，坚持自己的选择，才不随便跟一群不熟悉的人一起喝酒咧。
“好，就可乐。”男子突然有股被“冻到”的感觉，悻悻然地去帮她点饮料。
佟映晨吃着桌上没什么人动的炸薯条，没发现斜对面的男人正因为她刚才的几句对话而发笑。
可乐？！噗……
杜天海低头轻笑，觉得这女人真的很有出人意料的笑点，太好玩了。
昏暗的灯光下，杜天海搂着身边的女人，和一群朋友把酒言欢、有说有笑，但他注意力却不时地飘向佟映晨，留意着这个与这片环境如此格格不入的女人——

她的表情愈来愈无聊，他却反常地觉得愈来愈有趣……
一段时间后，她去洗手间，他也随后离开座位。
佟映晨从化妆室里走出来，便看到杜天海站在几步之外，双手插在口袋里，一副在等人的样子。
她走向他，等他说话。
他露出一个帅气的笑容，就说这女人聪明得很。
“感觉怎么样？”他问她。
“很饱。”她淡淡地答，好像喝太多汽水了，胃有点撑。
“我是问你看到我和别的女人在一起的感觉。”他笑道，真的觉得这女人很有料——笑料。
“抱着她们的人是你，为什么要问我有什么感觉？”她奇怪地反问，难道他带她来这里就是为了看她有什么反应吗？
“因为我结婚后也打算这样过生活，如果成天有人在我耳边吵吵闹闹的我可受不了。”他换个姿势，撑住她身后的墙壁，将她围在怀里，帅气的脸孔就贴在她眼前，害周遭的气氛变得有些暧昧。
她往后退一小步，靠着墙面，抬头看着他那张会害女人争风吃醋的俊脸，微眯起眼。
“杜先生，我觉得你好像没弄懂一件事。”
“请说。”他迷人地微笑。
“我们的婚姻——我是说如果你接受我的提议跟我结婚，那也只是一桩各取所需的交易而已，无关任何感情因素，所以你就尽管照你喜欢的方式去过生活，我说过我不会干涉你任何事情。”她慎重地表明自己的立场，要他千万别想太多，他们之间没有存在任何一丁点浪漫情怀，就算结了婚也是各过各的而已。
“你知不知道你现在看起来很像一个人？”他轻轻挑起她的下巴，细细端详她那张面如敷粉，唇若涂朱的容颜。
“谁？”她问。
“我哥。”他收起笑容，站直身子，一脸无趣地往回走。
她一头雾水地跟着他回到包厢，这次他主动开口——
“各位，我有件事要宣布。”
“今天你请客……”众人马上起哄，只有警觉性高的女人们嗅出情况有些不对劲，因为他跟着佟映晨离开，又和她一同回来……

“没问题，今天全场的消费都由我买单，因为我要结婚了。”他突如其来地宣布，也不管众人有没有心理准备。
“什么？！”现场果然一片惊呼连连，还夹杂着几声跌破杯盘的声音，尤其以女性们的反应最大。
但杜天海却笑得泰然自若，大手往后一捞——
“她，就是我要娶的女人。”他大声宣布喜讯，把身后的佟映晨拉进怀里，由身后拥抱住她，亲昵地在她耳畔低语：“佟映晨小姐，我接受你的求婚。”
content_en:
Since she couldn't wait for his reply for half a month, she simply went to his mother to test the water temperature and see if Mother Du's vision for choosing a wife was really as strict as he said... Well, she admitted that this move actually meant provoking him, because if Mother Du left a good impression on her, he wouldn't be able to use his parents as an excuse to reject her in the future, right?
Du Tianhai looked at her bright and confident eyes, and her fair and delicate face was adorned with a touch of wisdom...
"Smart woman." He raised his thick eyebrows slightly, pursed his thin lips slightly, and his unruly face was quite playful.
Suddenly throwing out such a sentence, his words sounded even more interesting, making her unclear whether he meant praise or criticism. Is this "smart" really a compliment to her, or is it an insinuation that she is scheming?
"Where are you taking me?" Unable to understand the mystery behind his words, she was a bit stubborn and refused to ask, and instead asked about their destination.
"Sold you." He raised his lips and replied in a non-serious manner.
"Please bid me a good price," she said nonchalantly, hoping that she was really worth a lot of money. These days, she has been looking for people everywhere, and she has hit a lot of long and short nails, and she is really lacking a lot.
"Haha... no problem, I'll cover it." He laughed loudly, but he didn't expect that this serious-looking woman would actually agree with his cold joke.
This is what makes him the most interesting! A woman with a restrained personality and a somewhat old-fashioned look would make some unexpected moves from time to time, which really made her more and more attracted to him.
boring! Is it that funny?
She gave him a cold look, feeling that this man's thoughts were really hard to understand. If she ever found out about him one day, she would most likely become insane herself.
She held the car window and looked out, and stopped talking along the way.
About twenty minutes later, they arrived at a membership-only bar. A group of his friends were already sitting in one of the semi-open private rooms. The men and women greeted him loudly when they saw him, especially the women dressed in hot clothes who were particularly enthusiastic.
"Ahai..."
"Xiaohai..."
"Sea..."
The sounds of snoring came and went, and Tong Yingchen's ears seemed to be drowned by the "sound of the waves", and even he was pushed to the back by the women vying to get close to him...
She didn't say anything, just stood back silently, watching him chatting with a group of women for a while before anyone noticed her presence.
"Who is she?" A woman with heavy makeup pointed at Tong Yingchen and asked, her tone obviously not friendly.
"Yes, who is she?" Everyone cast their eyes on her. Du Tianhai put his arm around the woman's shoulders and turned to look at her.
He looked at her and she looked at him. Tong Yingchen smiled and said nothing in the face of everyone's curious looks, and decided to leave this question to Du Tianhai to answer. Since he brought her here, he must have expected to be asked this question.
She looked at him, and she also wanted to know what kind of identity she was defined in his heart. He had not yet given an answer to her proposal.
"This one...she is Miss Tong Yingchen, who is very valuable, so I can't reveal anything more except her name." He raised his hand in an exaggerated manner and introduced her name solemnly, but vaguely mentioned her identity.
Everyone regarded his "performance" as a light and funny joke, and they laughed without asking any more questions. Anyway, everyone was just out to drink and have fun, and no one took it too seriously to explore anyone's background.
Seeing that Du Tianhai was still hugging the woman next to him, the women seemed not to care much about Tong Yingchen's existence, so they no longer focused on her.
"Hai, come and sit here."
"No, come and sit here..." Several women started fighting for Du Tianhai's seat again, and it took a while to decide his position.
Tong Yingchen took a seatDiagonally across from him, I saw him being sandwiched between the two groups of women very welcomely. The expression on his face seemed to be quite used to it, and he seemed to enjoy being surrounded like this...
The data is correct, this man is indeed very popular with women!
"What do you want to drink?" The man sitting next to Tong Yingchen leaned over and asked her.
She thought for a moment and said, "Coke."
"Clam?!" The man's mouth was like a freshly roasted clam
"It's fun." She repeated slowly and loudly, thinking that the other party didn't hear clearly because the music was too loud. In fact, she originally wanted to order oolong tea, but it probably wasn't available in the bar.
"Are you kidding me? No one comes here to drink soda." The man smiled sarcastically, thinking that this was not a fast food restaurant for children. Who would drink non-alcoholic drinks?
"I just want to drink Coke." She had a cold expression and insisted on her choice. She would not just drink with a group of unfamiliar people.
"Okay, just Coke." The man suddenly felt like he was "cold" and went to help her order a drink.
Tong Yingchen was eating the untouched French fries on the table, but she didn't realize that the man diagonally across from her was laughing because of her previous conversation.
Cola? ! Poof...
Du Tianhai lowered his head and chuckled, feeling that this woman was really funny and it was so funny.
Under the dim light, Du Tianhai hugged the woman next to him and drank and laughed with a group of friends, but his attention drifted to Tong Yingchen from time to time, paying attention to this woman who was so out of tune with this environment——
Her expression became more and more boring, but he found it abnormally more and more interesting...
After some time, she went to the bathroom and he left his seat.
Tong Yingchen walked out of the dressing room and saw Du Tianhai standing a few steps away, with his hands in his pockets, as if he was waiting for someone.
She walked towards him, waiting for him to speak.
He showed a handsome smile and said that this woman was very smart.
"How do you feel?" he asked her.
"Very full." She replied calmly, as if she had drank too much soda and her stomach was a little full.
"I'm asking how you feel when you see me with another woman." He laughed, really thinking that this woman was interesting - a joke.
"You are the one holding them, why do you ask me how I feel?" She asked strangely, did he bring her here just to see her reaction?
"Because I plan to live like this after I get married. I can't stand it if someone is noisy in my ears all day long." He changed his position, supported the wall behind her, and surrounded her in his arms. His handsome face was right in front of her eyes, making the surrounding atmosphere a bit ambiguous.
She took a small step back, leaned against the wall, looked up at his handsome face that would make women jealous, and narrowed her eyes slightly.
"Mr. Du, I feel like you don't understand one thing."
"Please." He smiled charmingly.
"Our marriage - I mean if you accept my proposal to marry me, it's just a deal where we each get what we need, and it has nothing to do with any emotional factors, so just live your life the way you like. I said I won't interfere with anything." She stated her position carefully and asked him not to think too much. There is no romantic feelings between them, and even if they get married, they will live their own lives.
"Do you know that you look like a person now?" He gently lifted her chin and took a closer look at her face, which looked like it was powdered, and her lips were like red.
"Who?" she asked.
"My brother." He put away his smile, stood up straight, and walked back with a bored look on his face.
She followed him back to the box confused, and this time he took the initiative to speak——
"Everyone, I have something to announce."
"You're treating me today..." Everyone immediately started shouting. Only the alert women could sense that something was wrong, because he left with Tong Yingchen and came back with her.…
"No problem, I will pay for all the expenses today because I am getting married." He announced suddenly, regardless of whether everyone was mentally prepared.
"What?!" As expected, the scene was filled with exclamations, mixed with several sounds of cups and plates falling, especially the women who had the biggest reaction.
But Du Tianhai smiled calmly and reached back with his big hand——
"She is the woman I want to marry." He loudly announced the good news, pulled Tong Yingchen into his arms, hugged her from behind, and whispered in her ear affectionately: "Miss Tong Yingchen, I accept your proposal."
